# Using the Insights Operator {#using-insights-operator}

The {{ insights_operator }} periodically gathers configuration and component failure status and, by default, reports that data every two hours to Red Hat. This information enables Red Hat to assess configuration and deeper failure data than is reported through Telemetry. Users of OpenShift Container Platform can display the report in the {{ insights_advisor_url }} service on {{ hybrid_console }}.
